# stunning_ui

A glassmorphic, physics-driven Flutter UI toolkit. One seed colour + style derives a full theme; accessible by default; chainable .stunning() effects.

## Setup (one line)
```dart
MaterialApp(theme: StunningTheme.dark(seedColor: Colors.cyanAccent).toThemeData(), home: ...)
```
Styles: StunningUIStyle.enterprise | minimal | gaming. Read the theme anywhere with StunningTheme.of(context).

## Chainable effects
```dart
widget.stunning().glow().tilt().springIn().glass()
Column(children: cards.stunningStagger())
```

## Components (52)
- **buttons**: StunningButton, StunningButtonSize, StunningButtonVariant
- **cards**: StunningTiltCard
- **core**: StunningAccent, StunningAnimatedTheme, StunningEffectTier, StunningGlassScope, StunningResponsiveCenter, StunningTappable, StunningUI
- **data_display**: StunningAvatar, StunningBadge, StunningBarChart, StunningDataTable, StunningTableStyle
- **feedback**: StunningDialog, StunningProgressBar, StunningProgressRing, StunningShimmer, StunningSkeleton, StunningToast, StunningTooltip
- **inputs**: StunningCheckbox, StunningDropdown, StunningRadio, StunningSegmentedControl, StunningSelect, StunningSlider, StunningSwitch, StunningTabs, StunningTextField
- **layout**: StunningAccordion, StunningCarousel, StunningDivider
- **lists**: StunningAnimatedListItem
- **modals**: StunningModal
- **navigation**: StunningAppBar, StunningBottomNav, StunningNavItem, StunningPagination, StunningSidebar, StunningSidebarItem
- **theme**: StunningGradients, StunningHarmony, StunningPalette, StunningRole, StunningSemantic, StunningSemantics, StunningSpring, StunningTheme, StunningUIStyle

## Conventions for correct code
- Colours come from the theme (StunningTheme.of(context): textPrimary, textSecondary, hintColor, iconColor, borderColor, primaryBrand, onColor(bg)). Do not hardcode Colors.white/black — the kit must work in light AND dark.
- Animation durations use StunningTheme.of(context).motion(context) so reduce-motion is honoured.
- Pass onChanged/onPressed: null to disable a control.
- Glass: use GlassSurface or .glass(); wrap a screen in StunningGlassScope to coalesce blur. Requires Flutter >= 3.41.
